stem: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) is most frequently observed on which side of the body?
explanation: Left-sided hernias account for the majority of CDH cases, likely due to the later closure of the left pleuroperitoneal membrane.
rationale: Consider the embryological timing of the closure of the pleuroperitoneal membranes.

optionExplanations.A: Right-sided hernias are less common, partly because the right pleuroperitoneal membrane usually closes earlier than the left.
optionExplanations.B: Left-sided hernias account for the majority of CDH cases, likely due to the later closure of the left pleuroperitoneal membrane.
optionExplanations.C: While bilateral defects can occur, they are extremely rare compared to unilateral defects.
optionExplanations.D: Anterior midline defects (Morgagni hernias) are rare, accounting for only about $2\%$ of cases.
